title: Topic 18
japanese_text: <u>職務</u> <u>怠慢だった</u>Aが、先週<u>解雇された</u>。Aは<u>度重なる</u>注意にもかかわらず、無断欠勤したり、仕事中に<u>私用</u>で勝手に外出したりと、日頃から<u>勤労して</u>いるとは言えない状態だった。しかし、Aは解雇通知を<u>不服だ</u>として、裁判を起こして争うそうだ。
english_translation: A was fired last week for neglect of her duties. Despite repeated warnings, she was absent from work without permission, went out on her own personal business during work hours, and certainly could not be described as working regularly. However, A is objecting to the dismissal notice and is going to court to fight the case.
